status: fixed before inspecting pilot gradient values
batch_selection: Traverse archived batches strictly before each checkpoint in order; keep a batch only when none of its sequence indices has appeared in an earlier retained batch. Retained batches are pairwise disjoint in training sequence indices.
gradient: FP32 task cross-entropy averaged over target positions in each source domain, multiplied by number of domain targets and divided by number of accepted final-layer expert occurrences in that domain/batch. No auxiliary loss or optimizer.
resolution: Per-weight batch mean is resolved if finite and absolute value > 1e-12. Count only resolved batch signs; a domain estimate requires at least 8 accepted contributing batches, 32 accepted routed occurrences, and 8 resolved batch signs.
group_aggregation: minimum across the two domains of abs(sum(resolved batch signs)/count(resolved batch signs)); unknown unless both domain estimates meet thresholds
precision: FP32 with TF32 disabled and deterministic PyTorch algorithms; sign/count accumulation integer and magnitude sums FP32
context_crossing: included in primary; full exclusion sensitivity still outstanding
